quranTranslation.text: And We prescribed for them therein: The life for the life, and the eye for the eye, and the nose for the nose, and the ear for the ear, and the tooth for the tooth, and for wounds retaliation. But whoso forgoeth it (in the way of charity) it shall be expiation for him. Whoso judgeth not by that which Allah hath revealed: such are wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „Oko za oko“ – oko kao organ.
explanation.en: “The eye for the eye” — the eye as an organ.

quranTranslation.text: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,

explanation.bs: Da se majci tvojoj oko obraduje – Musa vraćen majci.
explanation.en: “That her eyes might be refreshed” — Moses returned to his mother.

quranTranslation.text: Wherein is a gushing spring,

explanation.bs: U njemu je izvor tekući – عَيْن kao izvor.
explanation.en: Within it is a flowing spring — عَيْن as a spring.

quranTranslation.text: (O man), follow not that whereof thou hast no knowledge. Lo! the hearing and the sight and the heart - of each of these it will be asked.

explanation.bs: „Zaista, sluh i vid i srce – za svako od njih će se pitati.“
explanation.en: “The hearing and the sight and the heart — of each of these it will be asked.”

quranTranslation.text: Have they not travelled in the land, and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear? For indeed it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is the hearts, which are within the bosoms, that grow blind.

explanation.bs: Ne slijepe oči (الأَبْصَار), nego srca u grudima – vid i unutarnje sljepilo.
explanation.en: It is not eyes (الأَبْصَار) that are blinded, but hearts within the breasts — sight and inner blindness.

quranTranslation.text: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.

explanation.bs: Kao treptaj oka – brzina pogleda.
explanation.en: Like a glance of the eye — the swiftness of sight.

quranTranslation.text: And there may spring from you a nation who invite to goodness, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency. Such are they who are successful.

explanation.bs: „I neka iz vas bude zajednica koja poziva na dobro“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za خَيْر kao imenicu.
explanation.en: “And there may spring from you a nation who invite to goodness” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for خَيْر as a noun.

quranTranslation.text: It is prescribed for you, when death approacheth one of you, if he leave wealth, that he bequeath unto parents and near relatives in kindness. (This is) a duty for all those who ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „Kad smrt dođe nekome od vas, ako ostavlja imetak (خَيْرًا)…“ – ar-Rāġib: ovdje خَيْر znači imetak.
explanation.en: “When death approacheth one of you, if he leave wealth (خَيْرًا)…” — ar-Rāġib: here خَيْر means wealth.

quranTranslation.text: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,

explanation.bs: „Pa ko učini dobra teškog koliko trun, vidjet će ga.“
explanation.en: “And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then.”

quranTranslation.text: Whoso bringeth a good deed will receive tenfold the like thereof, while whoso bringeth an ill-deed will be awarded but the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.

explanation.bs: „Ko donese dobro djelo, njemu pripada deset puta toliko“ – حَسَنَة po Šerijatu.
explanation.en: “Whoso bringeth a good deed will receive tenfold the like thereof” — حَسَنَة by the Law.

quranTranslation.text: Wheresoever ye may be, death will overtake you, even though ye were in lofty towers. Yet if a happy thing befalleth them they say: This is from Allah; and if an evil thing befalleth them they say: This is of thy doing (O Muhammad). Say (unto them): All is from Allah. What is amiss with these people that they come not nigh to understand a happening?

explanation.bs: „A ako ih pogodi nešto dobro, kažu: Ovo je od Allaha“ – ar-Rāġib: plodnost, obilje i pobjeda.
explanation.en: “Yet if a happy thing befalleth them they say: This is from Allah” — ar-Rāġib: fertility, plenty and victory.

quranTranslation.text: And of them (also) is he who saith: "Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire."

explanation.bs: „Gospodaru naš, daj nam na ovom svijetu dobro i na onom svijetu dobro“ – riječ je حَسَنَة; mufesiri je tumače na više načina (zdravlje, znanje, ibadet; na ahiretu – Džennet).
explanation.en: “Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good” — the word is حَسَنَة; mufassirun explain it in several ways (well-being, knowledge, worship; in the Hereafter, Paradise).

quranTranslation.text: And when those who did wrong behold the doom, it will not be made light for them, nor will they be reprieved.

explanation.bs: „A kad oni koji su činili zulum vide kaznu, neće im se ona olakšati niti će im se odgoditi.“
explanation.en: “And when those who did wrong behold the doom, it will not be made light for them, nor will they be reprieved.”

quranTranslation.text: Say (unto them): On the day of the victory the faith of those who disbelieve (and who then will believe) will not avail them, neither will they be reprieved.

explanation.bs: „… na Dan pobjede neće koristiti nevjernicima njihovo vjerovanje, niti će im se odgoditi“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “On the day of the victory the faith of those who disbelieve … will not avail them, neither will they be reprieved” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Beside Him. So (try to) circumvent me, all of you, give me no respite.

explanation.bs: Hud svom narodu: „… pa svi zajedno smišljajte protiv mene, i ne dajte mi odgode!“ – izazov s pouzdanjem u Allaha; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Hūd to his people: “So (try to) circumvent me, all of you, give me no respite” — a challenge in trust in Allah; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: I give them rein (for) lo! My scheme is strong.

explanation.bs: „A Ja im puštam uzde – Moj plan je, zaista, čvrst“ – kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “I give them rein (for) lo! My scheme is strong” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites these words.

gloss.en: to give rein, to grant a long respite

quranTranslation.text: And let not those who disbelieve imagine that the rein We give them bodeth good unto their souls. We only give them rein that they may grow in sinfulness. And theirs will be a shameful doom.

explanation.bs: „Neka ne misle oni koji ne vjeruju da je dobro za njih to što im puštamo uzde …“ – vrijeme koje nije blagodat; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And let not those who disbelieve imagine that the rein We give them bodeth good unto their souls” — time that is no favour; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to give rein, to grant a long respite

quranTranslation.text: (And) the dwellers in Midian. And Moses was denied; but I indulged the disbelievers a long while, then I seized them, and how (terrible) was My abhorrence!

explanation.bs: „… pa sam nevjernicima pustio uzde, a zatim ih kaznio“ – dugo vrijeme, pa onda kazna, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “But I indulged the disbelievers a long while, then I seized them” — a long time, then the seizing, as befits Him.

gloss.en: to give rein, to grant a long respite

quranTranslation.text: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.

explanation.bs: „Zato daj vremena nevjernicima, pusti ih malo“ – isti korijen dvaput, u dva oblika; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while” — the same root twice, in two forms; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.

explanation.bs: „Ostavi Meni one koji poriču, koji su u blagodatima, i daj im još malo vremena“ – kratko, polagano vrijeme.
explanation.en: “Leave Me to deal with the deniers … and do thou respite them awhile” — a short, unhurried time.

quranTranslation.text: The chieftains of his people said: Lo! we see thee surely in plain error.

explanation.bs: „Prvaci njegova naroda kazaše: ‚Čini nam se da si ti u zabludi koja se vidi‘“ – Nuhovi prvaci; ar-Rāġib navodi izraz ‚rekoše prvaci njegova naroda‘, koji se ponavlja.
explanation.en: “The chieftains of his people said: Lo! we see thee surely in plain error” — Noah's chiefs; ar-Rāġib cites the recurring phrase ‘the chiefs of his people said’.

quranTranslation.text: (The Queen of Sheba) said (when she received the letter): O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter.

explanation.bs: „Reče ona: ‚O prvaci, meni je bačeno plemenito pismo‘“ – vijeće bez prijekora; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter” — a council with no blame attached; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And the angels called to him as he stood praying in the sanctuary: Allah giveth thee glad tidings of (a son whose name is) John, (who cometh) to confirm a word from Allah lordly, chaste, a prophet of the righteous.

explanation.bs: Meleki Zekeriji donose radosnu vijest o Jahji, koji će potvrditi Allahovu riječ, „i bit će poglavar, uzdržljiv, vjerovjesnik iz reda čestitih“ – ar-Rāġib: sayyid zbog plemenitosti duše.
explanation.en: The angels give Zachariah glad tidings of John, “to confirm a word from Allah lordly, chaste, a prophet of the righteous” — ar-Rāġib: sayyid for nobility of soul.

quranTranslation.text: And they raced with one another to the door, and she tore his shirt from behind, and they met her lord and master at the door. She said: What shall be his reward, who wisheth evil to thy folk, save prison or a painful doom?

explanation.bs: „… i kod vrata zatekoše njenog gospodara …“ – muž; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And they met her lord and master at the door” — the husband; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And they say: Our Lord! Lo! we obeyed our princes and great men, and they misled us from the Way.

explanation.bs: „Gospodaru naš, bili smo pokorni svojim poglavarima i svojim velikašima, i oni su nas odvukli s puta“ – oba izraza zajedno: vlast (sāda) i ugled (kubarāʾ).
explanation.en: “Our Lord! Lo! we obeyed our princes and great men, and they misled us from the Way” — both words together: rule (sāda) and standing (kubarāʾ).
